<template>
  <v-card color="grey-lighten-3">
    <v-layout>
      <v-app-bar
        color="white"
      >
        <template v-slot:prepend>
          <v-img src="@/assets/logo.png" :width="200" class="custom-v-img"></v-img>
        </template>

        <v-spacer></v-spacer>

        <v-btn icon @click="value = !value">
          <v-icon>mdi-account</v-icon>
        </v-btn>
        <v-btn v-show="value" @click="logout">
          Sair
        </v-btn>
      </v-app-bar>

      <v-main>
        <v-container fluid>
          <v-row dense>
            <v-col
              cols="6"
            >
              <v-card>
                <v-card-title>fdfdfdf</v-card-title>
              </v-card>
            </v-col>
          </v-row>
        </v-container>
      </v-main>
    </v-layout>
  </v-card>
</template>

<script>
export default {
  name: 'DashboardView',
  data() {
    return {
      value: false
    }
  },
  methods: {
    logout() {
      localStorage.removeItem('AUTH_TOKEN');
      this.$router.push(this.$route.query.redirect || '/login');
    }
  }
}

</script>
